summary: Frontend-only test of the CloudIVR UI/UX + a11y pass, logged in as Alice, at 1920px and 390px. Passed: Overview order (stats, then Suggested, then one promo in the slot, then Fax card, then Your numbers/Quick actions, then the New strip, then Recent activity); the What's new dialog; the sidebar's Outbound entry with 5 tabs, highlighted on campaign detail and ai-agents/new; the account menu (avatar + first name, email, Appearance light/dark, Language fr/en, Private mode masking, Settings/Help links, keyboard open, Sign out with the protected route sending you back to login; topbar-greeting is gone); number cards (center click does nothing, the Hours switch shows a toast with Undo and is restored, Open and the phone link both go to detail); number detail groups (Calls badge 'Keypad menu' lands on ivr, Connect goes to sip with no strip, Account shows Logs/Billing, Messages shows the 5 sub-tabs, ?tab= updates, deep-link to billing works); Settings index with 4 sections and the #webhooks hash scroll; Buy 3-step progress (1, then 2 after search, then 3 after pick; nothing bought); mobile bottom nav, More menu, Open button, and scrolling group pills and sub-tabs; caller-ID select aria-labels; the Fax history table has no empty th. No console errors on any page visited. Found 1 real layout bug (the Settings side index does not stay in place) and a few minor issues.

ui_bugs.issue: The side index has lg:sticky lg:top-24, but as a grid item it stretches to the full row height (measured 3694px). So it never sticks and scrolls off-screen once you scroll down. That defeats the point of a side index. Fix: add lg:self-start (or lg:h-fit) to the nav.

Clicking 'Community & rewards' scrolls to the end of the page, but that section cannot reach the top 20-40% band. The IntersectionObserver therefore keeps 'Notifications & integrations' highlighted (aria-current) instead of Community.
?tab=bogus shows the Overview content, but the panel wrapper testid becomes number-tabpanel-bogus. The overview group is selected correctly. Better to normalise tab to the resolved TABS id.

issues: The footer row (Renews / copy / call / Open) is not pinned to the bottom of the card (no mt-auto). Cards in the same row have different footer heights, and card 0 has empty space under its footer.
The floating support button sits over the last quick switch (Fax) and the Open button area on card 0. Consider bottom padding or moving the FAB.
The More sheet stays dark (civr-side) while the page is in light theme. Inconsistent, though readable.
Most of the Fax announcement card text stays in English ('New: Fax on your Business numbers', 'Send and receive faxes with 50 free pages every month...') while the rest of the page is translated.

action_items: Settings.js SectionIndex: add lg:self-start (or lg:h-fit) so the sticky side index stays in view.
Settings useActiveSection: when an index link is clicked, set active to that id (or handle the last section at page bottom).
NumberCard: put mt-auto on the footer row so footers line up across cards.
Optional: translate the FaxCard copy, theme the mobile More sheet in light mode, and keep the FAB from covering card controls on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: NumberDetail: the Fax sub-tab shows only when the number is fax-capable (capabilities.fax), not when it is on the Business plan. So Pro numbers (+12138340902) also show a Fax tab, while the card shows the Fax switch only for Business. Check that this is intended.
NumberDetail: the 'Replace number' button calls setParams({tab:'billing', replace:'1'}) directly and skips confirmLeave, unlike go().
AccountMenu trigger uses hard-coded text-[#d4d4d8]. It reads fine in light mode only because a theme override exists; prefer var(--c-text).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 9 requested areas pass; 1 medium layout bug and minor polish items)

seed_data_creation: None. Hours on +13346972125 was toggled on and then undone (now off, as before). IVR on +13346972125 was not touched and stays ON. No purchases, top-ups or faxes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each Playwright session starts with fresh localStorage (default theme = system, which is light in headless; the last session left it on dark). Dismiss cookie-allow-all, then click get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). Radix account menu: open the submenus by hovering topbar-theme-button or topbar-lang-switcher before clicking an option. Alice has campaigns (e.g. /app/campaigns/c6b3967e-...).
